summary.title: OWASP Threat Dragon
summary.one_liner: Threat Dragon is an open-source OWASP threat modelling tool available as a web app and as a desktop app, with the web version storing models in GitHub.
takeaways: Threat Dragon is an open-source OWASP threat modelling tool offered as a web app and a desktop app for MacOS, Windows and Linux.
The desktop app saves threat models to the local file system.
The online version stores its files in GitHub and requires signing in with a GitHub account that has write access to public repos.
The web and desktop versions have almost identical user experience, per the page.
Source code is on GitHub at OWASP/threat-dragon; it is an OWASP Lab project and bugs can be reported there.
summary.summary: The page is a short overview of OWASP Threat Dragon, an open-source threat modelling tool. It explains that the tool runs both as a web application and as a desktop application on MacOS, Windows and Linux. It contrasts storage: the desktop app saves models locally, while the web version stores files in GitHub and requires GitHub sign-in with write access to public repos. It also links to the source code repository for issues and change requests and notes it is an OWASP Lab project.
